pages.text: The fragments of understanding I have gathered do not feel random. They form paths—branches of thought that lead toward entire disciplines of magic.$(br2)At the Tome Table, Insight can unlock a school and then purchase spell nodes whose prerequisites have been met.

Mage Light stands outside the schools and is always known. School spells are learned when their nodes are purchased.$(br2)Resetting the Tome refunds purchased nodes and removes their usable spells, but these journal notes remain: forgetting how to cast is not the same as erasing what I once discovered.
pages.title: Learning and Forgetting
